zh: 修复 iOS 移动端侧边栏「开启新对话」按钮右半区域点击无响应问题：规范化 HStack 点击热区为完整卡片轮廓（RoundedRectangle），全宽 100% 灵敏响应触控交互，并在轻点后自动收起抽屉与触发中度触觉震动反馈。
消除主题明暗切换时的界面视觉延迟：为侧边栏搜索框、工具台/KPI/定时快捷按钮及底部操作栏全面注入主题感知前景色与强调色，联动全局 220ms 平滑动画曲线，彻底根除局部输入框滞后 1 秒刷新问题。
移动端人机交互与触控目标合规优化：严格遵循 Apple 人机界面规范（HIG），所有头部图标、关闭按钮与快捷操作栏全面达标 44x44pt 最小点击热区，并加入细腻触觉反馈（Haptic Feedback），大幅提升单手操作流畅度。
en: Fix asymmetric hit testing on iOS mobile drawer 'New Chat' button: standardize the touch target across the entire card boundary with RoundedRectangle and infinity width, ensuring 100% responsive clicks with automatic sidebar dismissal and medium haptic feedback.

Eliminate theme transition latency: explicitly bind theme-aware foreground styles and tint colors across drawer search field, quick action buttons, and footer controls, synchronized with a smooth 220ms easeInOut transition to remove the 1s delay.

Mobile interaction and Apple HIG touch-target compliance: ensure all header icons, close buttons, and navigation controls satisfy the 44x44pt minimum touch target, accompanied by subtle haptic feedback for a fluid single-handed mobile experience.
